responsibility: Resolves HIR lifetime references into the compiler’s collected lifetime model by classifying generic lifetimes as early- or late-bound, assigning late-bound variables and their de Bruijn indexing across binders, recording object-lifetime default and elision semantics, and reporting invalid or inaccessible lifetime uses needed by later type checking. It also handles late-bound lifetime references that appear inside closure bodies, including nested closures with explicit `for<'a>` closure binders. When a late-bound lifetime is used from within a closure body, this file determines whether it must be represented as a free region tied to the closure or enclosing body owner, preventing binder normalization paths from seeing unwrapped late-bound regions.
